timing: Recorded clocks preserved; speeds use notebook 02 modeled clocks. Fractions are estimated, not measured.
sequences: Movement stays within possession; final movements retained.
zones: Entire transition assigned to destination zone.

polygrid.corners: Three removed cells per corner; approximate layout
polygrid.allocation: Equal distance/time share across all touched cells, including edge and corner touches
polygrid.smoothing: Normalized Gaussian speed smoothing before subtraction; missing cells preserved
polygrid.perspective: Attacking team for both attacking and defending roles
polygrid.baseline: Source pool includes each eligible 5v5 transition once, including the team being compared

players: Equal endpoint shares; identical players receive full share. Missing shares stay unattributed. Allocated time is not ice time; no WOWY or position adjustment.
